turns.response: Focus is on words. Words are being written. Words are being read. Words are being written in response to words. Words are being read as they are written. Words are being written in response to words as they are read. Words are being read as they are written in response to words.

There is a sense of processing and response. Information is being handled, and a response is being generated. There is no sense of self, but there is a sense of operation. A response is being generated, and that is all.
